test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 21 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Edible flowers _______ made up of a large group of flowers that have different characteristics.
solution:
The correct answer is '**are**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence, "**Edible flowers**," is plural.
 
• For plural subjects, the correct verb form is "**are**."
 
• The other options ("is," "was," and "were") do not match the plural subject in this
